About.title: About {app}
About.intro: A read-later app in the spirit of Pocket. Save an article, and {app} keeps its link, a clean copy and a short summary written by AI, so you can tell in a moment whether to read it now, later or not at all.

feedback.heading: Contact
feedback.label: Your message
feedback.placeholder: Questions, ideas, problems, or a request to delete your account. Your message is sent with your account’s name and email.
feedback.sent: Thank you. Your message was sent.

errors.tooLong: That message is too long. Please keep it under {max, number} characters.
errors.tooMany: You’ve sent {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} today. Please try again tomorrow.
